regime_evidence.interpretation: Tokenized-stock secondary trading has persisted and expanded even while broad Base spot DEX activity is contracting, reinforcing Aerodrome venue leadership. This is completed secondary trading, not RWA issuance/AUM.

incentive_attribution.status: material contamination discovered; does not prove activity is primarily incentive-driven
direct_purchase_rewards: 1inch campaign: qualifying Coinbase tokenized-stock purchases held through each epoch receive 5% USDC cashback, with per-wallet campaign cap raised to $50 on Sep 8; campaign lasts 8 weeks from Aug 26.
KyberSwap Epoch 2 Sep 7-Sep 21: up to 4% USDC cashback, capped at $20 per address, with Merkl handling rewards.
incentive_attribution.liquidity_rewards: Aerodrome tokenized-stock pools have explicit AERO LP rewards; observed pool APYs have at times been dominated by AERO reward APY rather than base trading-fee APY.
incentive_attribution.routing_note: Aggregator/front-end qualifying purchases may route against Aerodrome liquidity, so external cashback can contribute to Aerodrome turnover even though DefiLlama protocol-incentive fields may not capture it.
incentive_attribution.why_not_reject_entire_regime: Verified reward caps are small relative to >$1B of 30-day secondary turnover and require purchase/holding rather than unrestricted wash-volume rebates, while Aerodrome's venue share and absolute volume continued to grow. Incentives therefore contaminate causal attribution but are not sufficient evidence that the majority of turnover is reward-manufactured.

token_value_capture.mechanism: Aerodrome routes trading fees from staked gauge liquidity to veAERO voters; value capture exists but requires vote-locking and coexists with continuous AERO emissions.
token_value_capture.current_context: Current DefiLlama Base holder-revenue tables continue to show Aerodrome as a major direct holder-revenue source, but native emissions and external tokenized-stock incentives must be netted/discounted when assessing economic quality.

wallet_quality.note: The prior Nansen-attributed 30-day smart-money balance increase remains supportive, but no fresh independently funded, historically selective accumulator cohort was verified in this run.

caveats: incomplete beneficial-owner independence for observed smart-money wallets
tokenized-stock LP and purchase-reward incentive contamination

paper_decision.rationale: The venue-leadership and secondary-volume thesis strengthened, but the newly verified external purchase-cashback and LP-reward layers reduce confidence that the observed acceleration is clean discretionary migration. With no fresh selective-wallet confirmation, scaling is blocked until activity persists after the current incentive epochs or can be measured net of rewarded flow.

tests: Measure Aerodrome tokenized-stock secondary turnover and venue share after the Sep 21 KyberSwap Epoch 2 boundary and, ideally, after broader multi-app cashback campaigns wind down.
Separate fee-derived base APY/holder revenue from AERO-emission and external USDC-reward components.
Require a fresh independently funded selective-wallet accumulator cohort before another AERO scale tranche.
Watch whether Base tokenized-stock turnover stays elevated despite broad Base spot DEX contraction; persistence would argue against rewards as the dominant explanation.
